scientific_integrity: Exact matrix identities and a mathematical proof, supported by exact-rational finite regression tests. Prior literature comparisons are limited to accessible investigated sources; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectra concern one unassembled scalar Q1 orthotope with a convex consistent/row-lumped mass blend and no essential boundary constraints. For alpha>0 the mass is generally non-diagonal. No claim is made for assembled grids, distorted elements, elasticity, dispersion accuracy or computational benefit.
title: Exact mode-switching thresholds for blended-mass multilinear wave elements
